summary.text: Alana DiMario is a Democratic state senator from Rhode Island who has represented District 36 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
A mental health counselor, she has served in the Senate since January 5, 2021.

paragraphs.text: Alana DiMario lives in Narragansett, Rhode Island.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Wells College and a master's degree in clinical psychology from Bridgewater State University.
Her career experience includes working as a mental health counselor in private practice.
DiMario assumed office in the Rhode Island State Senate on January 5, 2021, succeeding James Sheehan, and her current term ends on January 5, 2027.
Ballotpedia lists her as chair of the Environment and Agriculture Committee and a member of the Health and Human Services Committee for 2023-2024.
Ballotpedia also lists a 2018 Democratic primary loss for this seat.
